title: ImUi Color Edit Numeric Readout v1
problem: Close the next bounded Dear ImGui `ColorEdit4` display gap by showing RGB and HSV numeric readouts in the editor-owned `ColorEdit` popup, without adding editable numeric input modes or widening `fret-imui` / runtime contracts.

repro.summary: Editor `ColorEdit` popup now renders RGB/HSV numeric readouts between the HSV picker and preset palette, with alpha percent shown when `show_alpha=true`.
commands: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast
cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_surface_policy --no-fail-fast

gates.name: focused color edit tests
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui color_edit --no-fail-fast

gates.name: imui editor surface policy
gates.command: cargo nextest run -p fret-ui-editor --features imui --test imui_surface_policy --no-fail-fast

continue_policy.notes: This readout-only slice is closed. Editable RGB/HSV numeric input modes are covered by `imui-color-edit-numeric-input-v1`, and per-control popup defaults are covered by `imui-color-edit-popup-options-v1`. Start separate follow-ons for color history, eyedropper integration, palette customization, or color drag/drop payloads.
